notes: North is up. Names printed without a suffix are written with 'Street' (HOPPLE, RAWSON, TOWNSHIP). Spring Grove Av. (100') comes south across Hopple, runs SSE, then curves east to run E-W across the middle of the sheet to Garrard and beyond; the curve centreline was traced from both edges and is given as bends. Rawson's west line is the continuation of the outer edge of the curve, so Rawson/Spring Grove is a T on the curve centreline. The street leaving the north side of Hopple at x~2786 is not named on this sheet; it is Meeker (key map and sheet 280). The street north of Hopple opposite Garrard is narrower (~30 ft) and ~40 px east of Garrard's line; sheet 280 names it Garrard Av., so Hopple/Garrard is recorded as a cross (centre of the four corners). Township jogs at Garrard: the west piece (labelled TOWNSHIP, 40') meets Garrard's west line at y~6303 and Garrard's east line is unbroken there; the street leaving Garrard's east side ~75 ft further south (y~6755, ~37 ft, 4in water pipe) is Township on sheet 281 (lot no. 1250 vs 1300 west of Garrard), recorded as 'Township Street (east of Garrard)'. Willow Lane (20') runs from a rear lot line east to Garrard. Circled numbers (68, 64, 77, 102, 62) are grade marks. Hopple, Spring Grove (north leg), Spring Grove (east leg) and Township run off the drawn area; those are not ends.
